name: adhesive
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is also grappled by it escape DC 13. Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
